whyForBowfishing: Bowfishers care about the weather because it changes the water and the night: rain muddies the water and moves the lake level, cloud decides whether a bright moon lights the water, and a sharp air-temperature swing or a passing front means conditions are changing and Lake and Water Temp should re-check. Barometric pressure is shown in the app, but there is no evidence it changes where target species are, so it earns very little here. The score asks: does every lake get real, current rain, cloud and temperature readings, and a 'weather is changing' signal that works?
measurement: Domain capability score (Cortex scoring.md SC-02, SC-03): how far Sector can trust the Weather Brain's published per-lake weather truth. Not operational health, not production readiness, not a forecast-skill metric, not comparable with any other Brain's score.
question: Per lake, does the Weather Brain publish real measured or official-forecast rain (now and expected), cloud, air temperature and a weather-change signal whose every rule could be evaluated, and has that output passed the validation pre-registered in docs/brains/WEATHER_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 5?
unknownPolicy: Unknown counts against the Brain everywhere (owner rule 2026-11-23: nothing should show unknown). A lake, tile or field that is unknown, unavailable, blocked or abstained earns 0 and stays in every denominator. Unknown is never rewarded or excluded to make a share look better. Every per-lake share therefore divides by ONE fixed denominator, all the lakes the Brain is meant to cover; a lake with no state (blocked, never computed, errored) is in it and earns 0. A Brain-level fact that is not published scores 0 and lowers completeness: both count as 0, never as excluded. Filling an unknown with an estimate is worse still: it is an invented value, which the validation checks fail, so the only way to remove an unknown is real data.
scope: Every per-lake share divides by the whole directory (/brains/weather.directoryLakeCount, 621 lakes), and a lake counts only if its /lakes/{k}/states/weather is fresh at scoring time: freshness.freshUntil later than the moment the scorer runs. A lake outside NWS coverage (BLOCKED), never computed, errored before its first state, or with an expired state left behind after it later errored or became BLOCKED, earns 0. Validation fleet-wide.
dimensionClasses: Cortex scoring.md SC-09: CAP bowfishing capability, COV coverage, PRED prediction quality, VAL validation against independent data, ENG engineering completion, VOL research volume. This draft has no ENG or VOL dimension.
unscoredWhen: The registry /brains/weather is absent or has never carried lastSuccessfulRun (the Brain has never published). The scorer then writes NO score block: the Brain is UNSCORED, never 0. Today this holds (the Brain is PARKED, has no live writer run, and run.py --write refuses).

dimensions.label: Pre-registered validation (plan section 5)

scale.absent: UNKNOWN: scores 0 and lowers completeness (an unknown counts as 0, never excluded); the validation gate still fires

dimensions.note: The Weather publication contract declares /validation/weather; the runtime does not write it yet (only Moon and Generation do). Until it does, this dimension is UNKNOWN. See validationStatusMeaning for what each status must mean.
dimensions.why: Only a check against independent stations shows the rain, temperature and change signal describe the water the bowfisher is on.

dimensions.label: Rain now and rain expected
dimensions.fact: count of directory lakes whose state is fresh (/lakes/{k}/states/weather.freshness.freshUntil > scoring time) and has sky.rain.lastHourIn non-null AND sky.rain.forecastNext6hIn non-null / /brains/weather.directoryLakeCount
dimensions.why: Rain is the weather that most changes a bowfishing night: it muddies the water and moves the lake level, and rain expected soon is the cue to re-check clarity and stage.
dimensions.note: A null in either field is an unknown and earns nothing. Whether a rain-onset call was right is validation (plan 5.3), not this dimension.

dimensions.label: Directory lakes with a Weather state
dimensions.fact: count of directory lakes with a fresh state (/lakes/{k}/states/weather.freshness.freshUntil > scoring time) / /brains/weather.directoryLakeCount
dimensions.note: Lakes outside NWS coverage are BLOCKED (gap WX-004) and stay in the denominator: abstaining is honest, but an unknown lake counts against the Brain.
dimensions.why: A lake with no Weather state gets no rain or cloud reading at all.

dimensions.label: Supported lakes at readiness CALIBRATION (kind observation, not stale, nothing missing)
dimensions.fact: count of directory lakes whose state is fresh (/lakes/{k}/states/weather.freshness.freshUntil > scoring time), has kind 'observation' and an empty 'missing' list / /brains/weather.directoryLakeCount
dimensions.note: The per-lake form of readiness CALIBRATION (kind observation, nothing missing), with staleness judged at scoring time instead of the registry's readinessCounts, which only describe the last run. DEGRADED, BLOCKED, DISCOVERED and expired lakes earn nothing and stay in the denominator.
dimensions.why: A stale or partly missing state can hide the rain or cloud that decides the night.

dimensions.label: Weather-change signal with every rule evaluated
dimensions.fact: count of directory lakes whose state is fresh (/lakes/{k}/states/weather.freshness.freshUntil > scoring time) and has weatherChange.unknown absent or an empty list / /brains/weather.directoryLakeCount
dimensions.note: A rule that cannot be evaluated makes the lake WATCH (owner decision 2026-11-22), so a high WATCH share measures data gaps, not weather. This dimension credits states whose signal rests on complete inputs. It says nothing about whether the signal is right (that is validation, plan 5.3).
dimensions.why: The 'weather is changing' signal (rain onset, front passage, air-temperature swing) is what makes Lake and Water Temp re-check; a rule that cannot be evaluated is an unknown and counts against.

dimensions.label: Barometric 3 h trend published
dimensions.fact: count of directory lakes whose state is fresh (/lakes/{k}/states/weather.freshness.freshUntil > scoring time) and has pressure.trend3h non-null / /brains/weather.directoryLakeCount
dimensions.note: The trend is still an input to the change signal. A pressure FORECAST is not credited anywhere: none exists (gap WX-003).
dimensions.why: Shown in the app, but no evidence ties pressure to where target species are, so it carries a token weight.

validationStatusMeaning.source: docs/brains/WEATHER_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 5, pre-registered 2026-11-22 before any data. Thresholds are not restated here; they are the plan's, and a failed criterion is reported, never tuned away.
validationStatusMeaning.newInThisDraft: The plan defines PASS and FAIL per criterion and no partial tier (a failed criterion keeps its gap open). The PARTIAL tier, its 7.0 cap, and treating INSUFFICIENT like FAIL for this status are new in this draft and need the owner's approval.
validationStatusMeaning.VALIDATED: 5.1 fidelity PASS (14 days), 5.2 representativeness PASS on its 30-day window with the minimum sample met (500 pairs, 20 lakes), and 5.3 change signal PASS for both RAIN_ONSET and FRONT_PASSAGE on its 60-day window.
validationStatusMeaning.PARTIAL: At least one of 5.1, 5.2, 5.3 scored PASS, every other criterion NOT YET SCORED (its window still running), and none FAILED or INSUFFICIENT.
validationStatusMeaning.NOT_VALIDATED: Nothing scored yet, or ANY criterion FAILED or INSUFFICIENT. A failed criterion is never credited; it stays NOT_VALIDATED until a new, separately pre-registered version (for example a thresholds-v2 release) passes. INSUFFICIENT is never PASS.
validationStatusMeaning.whoSetsIt: The Weather Brain's validation record (a reviewed change that writes /validation/weather), never the scorer and never Ops.

freshnessAtScoringTime: Freshness at scoring time: every per-lake fact counts only if the lake's state is current WHEN THE SCORER RUNS, judged from a timestamp in the published state, never from a flag written at publish time. A lake whose state has expired (the Brain stopped updating it, it errored after an earlier publish, or it is now BLOCKED with an old state left behind) earns 0. Weather: /lakes/{k}/states/weather.freshness.freshUntil (adaptive, at most 4 h after the observation) must be later than scoring time. The timestamp is already published; no runtime change is needed.
